query:
SELECT t.id
            FROM rb_team t
            LEFT JOIN rb_team_puzzle tp ON tp.team_id = t.id AND tp.pstate = 1
            WHERE t.game_id = $1 AND t.tstate > 0
            GROUP BY t.id
            ORDER BY t.tstate DESC,
                finish_at ASC NULLS LAST,
                COUNT(tp.puzzle_id) DESC,
                MAX(tp.solve_at) ASC NULLS LAST;
